subject: Pilot finish — performance snapshot & 10-15 min micro-quote ask
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Shah <anika@clearmart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up post run: next steps and a tiny ask

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for running the 30-day pilot with our LLM serving stack. Team really enjoyed working with yours. We pulled a short summary attached (clearcart-pilot-results-20260709.pdf) but wanted to highlight the three numbers most teams care about right away:

- Token cost per session: down 48% vs your baseline (projected monthly savings ~$18k at current volume)
- Median tail latency: 140ms (95th: 290ms) on your production sequence mix
- End-to-end accuracy lift on reranking experiments: +6.2% relative (A/B) on the basket-match set

If these look right to you, would you be open to a 10–15 minute call next week for a 1–2 sentence quote we can include in a short case summary? No heavy marketing asks — just one line and permission to publish the metrics snapshot.

Proposed times: Tue 7/13 10:00–10:15 PT, Wed 7/14 14:00–14:15 PT. If neither works, happy to work around your calendar.

Attachments: clearcart-pilot-results-20260709.pdf (summary), kv-cache-dashboard-clip.png (screenshot)

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Anika Shah <anika@clearmart.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@clearmart.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up post run: next steps and a tiny ask

Markus —

Really appreciate the concise summary. Those headline numbers match what we saw on our side in the last two weeks. The $18k/month projection checks out against our average session volume.

Happy to give a one-line quote and to confirm metrics publication, but two small asks before we do that: 1) can you redact the exact sample IDs in appendix A of the PDF (we have a data policy around sample traces) and 2) can you add a short sentence noting we ran the reranker on a held-out traffic slice?

Tue 7/13 10:00 PT works for me. Please send the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Anika Shah
Head of Product Analytics | ClearCart
anika@clearmart.com | (212) 555-4401

If it's helpful, Marissa will capture the final quote and do the tiny doc publish. Ben will join to take down any technical follow-ups.

Attachments: clearcart-pilot-results-20260712.pdf

Best,
Markus
